patch_description:
Replicate the structure of the best-performing prior (score 1.07) which uses:
1. Two-axis non-commuting input mixer (RY + RX) 
2. Complete-graph CZ split into two halves with a mid-circuit RY+RX mixer between them
3. Two-axis output mixer (RZ + RX)

The mid-mixer breaks the commutativity of the CZ layers, dramatically increasing expressivity. The CZ gates use the one-factorization of K8 for optimal parallel depth. This gives 6 shared params per block × 6 blocks = 36 circuit + 2 readout = 38 total params, matching the best prior.
